# CSC DOST

> Digital Assistance & Information Service Desk operated by Authorized CSC VLE

CSC DOST (cscdost.com) is operated by Authorized CSC Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) Wasim Ahmad Khanday (CSC ID: 212515670018, Registration Date: 11-11-2020) issued by CSC e-Governance Services India Limited, Ministry of Electronics & IT, Government of India.

## Main Pages & Services
- [Sarkari Results Desk](https://www.cscdost.com/#sarkari-portal-section): Latest government job results, answer keys, admit cards, and notifications.
- [Digital Services Desk](https://www.cscdost.com/#services-section): Online application assistance for PAN Card, Voter ID, e-Shram, Passport, and certificates.
- [Application Tracker](https://www.cscdost.com/#track-section): Live status check and token receipt download portal.
- [CSC Centre Info](https://www.cscdost.com/#node-info): Authorized VLE Certificate proof, location, contact, and physical station info.

## Official Disclaimer
CSC DOST (cscdost.com) is a private digital assistance portal facilitating online form filing. Official government portals can be accessed directly at [csc.gov.in](https://csc.gov.in) and [digitalseva.csc.gov.in](https://digitalseva.csc.gov.in).
